void-black.$description: Void Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, body copy, icons, nav labels, metadata

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted helper text, tertiary metadata, inactive icon strokes

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text, light borders, disabled strokes

hairline.$description: Hairline — Input borders, dividers, subtle separators

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Canvas background, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

reactor-green.$description: Reactor Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

voltage-pink.$description: Voltage Pink — Secondary accent for live indicators, countdown timers, hot tags, creator highlights

onyx.$description: Onyx — Icon fills, logo mark, maximum-contrast text on light backgrounds

monumentgrotesk.$description: Sole typeface across all UI: nav labels, body text, button text, metadata, card titles. The custom geometric grotesque's compressed forms and uniform 410–500 weights create a label-density voice rather than a reading voice; it treats copy as UI chrome, not as prose. No display-weight contrast is used — hierarchy is achieved through size and color, not weight amplitude.
